items.title: Jack DeJohnette — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I have a half-sister who's ten years older than I am named Izola but last I knew she was in a nursing home.

ctx.x: And do you have any siblings?
I have a half-sister who's ten years older than I am named Izola but last I knew she was in a nursing home. She was having some mental problems, I don't know whether she's alive or dead.
So, essentially you were raised as a single child?
